institutions.name: KAIST
aliases: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology

institutions.name: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

programmes.name: Computer Science (major after first year)
programmes.duration: Normally 4 years; confirm individual study plan
programmes.credits: Not published in checked course list
programmes.description: Study how software, algorithms and computer systems work.
programmes.curriculum: Current course examples: programming, data structures, algorithms, systems and AI. The 2027 admission is university-wide; choose a major after year one.
programmes.practical: Programming project courses are listed; placements are not guaranteed.

programmes.name: Electrical Engineering (major after first year)
programmes.duration: Normally 4 years; confirm individual study plan
programmes.credits: More than 138 KAIST institutional credits; requirements for 2023 onward
programmes.description: Explore circuits, signals and electronic systems.
programmes.curriculum: Department rules combine core electrical engineering, electives, design labs and research. Current course list includes circuits, programming and machine learning.
programmes.practical: Electronics design labs and a co-op credit policy are documented; no guaranteed placement.

programmes.name: Materials Science and Engineering (major after first year)
programmes.duration: Normally 4 years; confirm individual study plan
programmes.credits: More than 138 KAIST institutional credits; 2026 onward rules
programmes.description: Investigate how the structure of materials changes their properties.
programmes.curriculum: 2026 onward rules: 18 major core credits, 24 major elective credits and research, alongside common degree requirements.
programmes.practical: Three research credits required, with double-major exceptions.

programmes.name: Biological Sciences (major after first year)
programmes.duration: Normally 4 years; confirm individual study plan
programmes.credits: At least 138 KAIST institutional credits; 2024 onward rules
programmes.description: Learn how cells, molecules and living systems function.
programmes.curriculum: 2024 onward curriculum includes molecular biology, biochemistry, biotechnology, cell biology and electives.
programmes.practical: Biochemistry and cell-biology labs; graduation research and a documented 24-week co-op credit route.

programmes.name: Biotechnology and Business
programmes.description: Connect life science and biotechnology with how businesses operate.
programmes.curriculum: Life science and biotechnology plus accounting, finance, economics, marketing and operations. Programme-based direct admission is available.

programmes.name: Mathematics and Economics
programmes.description: Use mathematical reasoning to understand economic problems.
programmes.curriculum: Joint science/business degree with mathematics, economics, quantitative reasoning and communication. Direct programme application available.
programmes.practical: Internship or placement requirement not verified.

programmes.name: Data Science and Technology
programmes.description: Learn to turn large datasets into useful explanations.
programmes.curriculum: Mathematics, programming, machine learning, databases and visualisation. Enter a school first and seek major declaration after year one; this is not guaranteed direct entry to DSCT.
programmes.practical: Overview documents hands-on data analysis; placement not guaranteed.

programmes.name: Science
programmes.description: Explore science before choosing a major, including biology, computing, engineering systems or mathematics.
programmes.curriculum: 24 subjects with a major, electives and breadth study. Current catalogue offers more than 40 majors.
programmes.practical: Practical experience depends on chosen subjects; no universal internship claimed.

programmes.name: Commerce
programmes.description: Study how organisations and economies make decisions.
programmes.curriculum: Commerce foundations, a major or double major, electives and breadth subjects.
programmes.practical: Teamwork and case studies documented; internship availability must be checked.

programmes.name: Informatics with a Humanities co-major
programmes.description: Combine information systems or computer science with a humanities subject.
programmes.curriculum: Programming, databases, systems analysis, systems development and project management; co-major options include politics, sociology or psychology.
programmes.practical: Applied systems-development coursework; placement not verified.
programmes.campus: Cape Town; exact teaching venue to confirm

programmes.name: Architectural Studies
programmes.description: Explore the design of buildings and their social and environmental setting.
programmes.curriculum: Design, theory and practical concerns of the built environment. This undergraduate degree is a stage toward further professional study.
programmes.practical: Design work is central; a portfolio is required for application.
programmes.campus: Cape Town; exact teaching venue to confirm

programmes.name: Graphic Design / Diseño Gráfico
programmes.duration: Current faculty plan shows 5 years including CBC; confirm conflicting older plan
programmes.credits: Contact hours listed; no credit total verified
programmes.description: Study visual communication, typography and the design of information.
programmes.curriculum: CBC first cycle, then design studios, morphology, typography, communication, history, technology and directed electives.
programmes.practical: Drawing and design studio coursework. Placement requirement not verified.
programmes.campus: FADU, Buenos Aires; CBC location assigned separately

routes.name: International freshman · choose major after year one
routes.applicant: Kazakhstan applicant with an appropriate secondary qualification; no prior tests assumed
routes.eligibility: Foreign-citizenship and parent/schooling conditions apply. Finish high school by 31 August 2027 for fall entry; standardized report, English evidence and essays required. Interview if requested.
routes.recognition: Exact acceptance of a Kazakhstan Grade11 Attestat requires confirmation; do not assume UNT is an accepted standardized report.
routes.subjects: Strong mathematics/science preparation encouraged; major-specific school prerequisites not separately verified.

SAT.detail: One of the accepted standardized reports; not compulsory if another accepted result is supplied.

UNT.detail: National entrance exams are listed generically; UNT acceptance specifically not confirmed.

ENGLISH.detail: English test required unless approved English-medium-school or listed nationality exemption; request confirmation.

IELTS.detail: One English test option; recommended 6.5 in 2027 guide, not a published guaranteed-entry threshold.

TOEFL.detail: One English test option; guide has date-dependent scoring and validity rules to clarify.

tuition.note: Undated current cost table; not a confirmed 2027 fee. Scholarship shown separately.

routes.mandatoryFees: 2027 application fee USD80; confirm fee-waiver eligibility. Insurance and other expenses are separate.
routes.living: Undated official estimate: housing KRW1328000/year and food KRW5475000/year; checked 2026-11-14. Scholarship stipend may not cover all living expenses.
routes.nextAction: Ask admissions to confirm the exact Kazakh diploma and accepted standardized report before booking tests.

awards.name: KAIST Scholarship
awards.benefits: Full tuition for 8 semesters, KRW350000 monthly living allowance and medical insurance. This is maintenance support, not a guarantee that every expense is paid.
awards.eligibility: International Student Admission applicants admitted with scholarship; citizenship and academic admission rules apply.
awards.application: Tick KAIST scholarship in the financial-resources section of the admission form; no separate award application.
awards.renewal: Maintain GPA above 2.7/4.3 after freshman year; confirm terms in offer.
awards.upfront: Application fee, travel, visa, initial housing and living costs may remain; amounts not verified.

awards.name: Global Learners Scholarship · nationality eligibility unconfirmed
awards.benefits: Full tuition waiver for successful awardees. Discretionary top-ups are not promised; living costs remain.
awards.eligibility: Underrepresented-nationality undergraduate applicants; Kazakhstan eligibility is not established by the checked page.
awards.application: Automatic consideration; no separate application. Ask admissions to confirm nationality eligibility.
awards.renewal: Normal study duration subject to satisfactory academic performance; exact academic condition to confirm.
awards.upfront: Application, visa, travel and living costs may be due before any award support.
